'''Lawdrin Mendair''' was a [[Redarm]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
He had a drinking problem and was told to tip out all his brandy on the way to [[Ebou Dar]]. While in the Rahad in Ebou Dar he was killed by the ''[[gholam]]'' trying to locate the [[Bowl of the Winds]].
